records.source: Evelyn is covering her eyes.
records.translation: 伊芙琳遮住了雙眼。

records.source: I had to close my eyes during most of it...$s
records.translation: 大部分時間我都不得不閉上眼睛……$s

records.source: I grew up watching old sci-fi flicks, so I'm interested to see a modern take on the genre.
records.translation: 我是看著老科幻片長大的，所以很想看看現代人如何詮釋這種類型。

records.source: Hah! It wasn't what I expected, but I ended up really liking it! I really identified with Wumbus.$h
records.translation: 哈！和預期不太一樣，但最後我真的很喜歡！我非常認同旺巴斯。$h

records.source: I'm usually working all the time, so it's really nice to do something like this.
records.translation: 我平常總是在工作，所以能做這種事真的很不錯。

records.source: Not bad! I wonder if they have any merchandise I could stock...
records.translation: 不錯！不知道他們有沒有什麼周邊商品能讓我進貨……

records.source: I can't believe they made a Prairie King movie... I hope it's good!
records.translation: 真不敢相信他們拍了草原王電影……希望會很好看！

records.source: Listen... it's got that old familiar music.$h
records.translation: 聽……是那段熟悉的老配樂。$h

records.source: Well the acting was awful, but I still had a great time.$h
records.translation: 嗯，演技糟透了，不過我還是看得很開心。$h

records.source: I'm excited to 'explore our vibrant world'... aren't you?$h
records.translation: 想到要「探索生機蓬勃的世界」，我就好興奮……你呢？$h

records.source: I didn't know that!
records.translation: 我都不知道！

records.source: That was really interesting. I liked the raccoons the best... they're so cute!$h
records.translation: 真的很有意思。我最喜歡浣熊……牠們太可愛了！$h

records.source: I love horror movies... I hope it's scary!$h
records.translation: 我喜歡恐怖電影……希望真的夠嚇人！$h

records.source: Haha! It's not scary, but I love it.$h
records.translation: 哈哈！一點也不可怕，不過我很喜歡。$h

records.source: Abigail is giggling!
records.translation: 阿比蓋爾咯咯笑個不停！

records.source: That was pretty campy, but I liked it.$h
records.translation: 這部片挺浮誇俗氣，不過我喜歡。$h

records.source: Hey! Thanks for inviting me, I love going to the movies.$h
records.translation: 嘿！謝謝你邀請我，我最喜歡看電影了。$h

records.source: That was interesting... I wonder what I would've done in the same situation?
records.translation: 真有意思……不知道自己遇到同樣的情況會怎麼做？

records.source: From seeing the trailer, this one looks like a real snoozefest...$6
records.translation: 看預告片就知道，這部片肯定會讓人睡翻……$6

records.source: Wake me up if anything interesting happens.$6
records.translation: 有什麼有趣的事再叫醒我。$6

records.source: *yawn*... that was pretty boring, wasn't it?$6
records.translation: *哈欠*……實在挺無聊，對吧？$6

records.source: I've always loved movies about the wild west, so I'm really excited to see this!
records.translation: 我一直很喜歡以西部荒野為題材的電影，所以非常期待！

records.source: That was great! It really felt authentic, with the costumes and everything.
records.translation: 真的很棒！服裝和其他細節都讓人覺得十分寫實。

records.source: This movie looks so cute, I was really hoping someone would invite me!
records.translation: 這部電影看起來太可愛了，我一直希望有人會邀請我！

records.source: I hope the poor little guy will be okay...$s
records.translation: 希望那個可憐的小傢伙平安無事……$s

records.source: That was adorable. Thanks so much for inviting me to this!
records.translation: 實在太可愛了。非常謝謝你邀請我來看！

records.source: '{0}'... I have no idea what this is about! I hope it's not violent.
records.translation: 「{0}」……我完全不知道這部片在演什麼！希望不會太暴力。

records.source: That wasn't bad! I'll have to ask Abigail about it when I'm home, I'm sure she's seen it.$h
records.translation: 還不錯！回家後得問問阿比蓋爾，我敢肯定她已經看過了。$h

records.source: I have a feeling this one's going to be a let-down... But I'm still interested to give it a try.
records.translation: 我有預感這部片會令人失望……不過還是想試著看看。

records.source: That was silly... I bet Pierre would like it.$s
records.translation: 真傻氣……皮埃爾一定會喜歡。$s

records.source: I'm nervous about this one... *gulp*
records.translation: 這部片讓我有點緊張……*吞口水*

records.source: I'm scared!$8
records.translation: 我好害怕！$8

records.source: Harvey is shaking!
records.translation: 哈維渾身發抖！

records.source: I have a fear of heights, so those soaring aerial shots really got to me... Still, I had a good time overall.$h
records.translation: 我有懼高症，所以那些高空航拍鏡頭真的讓我受不了……不過整體而言，我看得很開心。$h

records.source: I read a glowing review of this movie in the Zuzu City Times...
records.translation: 我在《祖祖市時報》上讀到一篇對這部電影讚譽有加的影評……

records.source: It really makes you think, doesn't it?
records.translation: 真的會讓人深思，對吧？

records.source: That was outstanding! I'm really glad that you brought me out for this, @.$h
records.translation: 實在太傑出了！@，真的很高興你帶我來看。$h

records.source: I don't watch a lot of movies, but this one's been well-received, right?
records.translation: 我不常看電影，不過這部片的評價很好，對吧？

records.source: That was interesting! I'm going to be thinking about {0} one for a while.
records.translation: 真有意思！接下來有一陣子，我大概都會思考 {0}。

records.source: This movie seems a little intense for me...$s
records.translation: 這部電影對我而言似乎有點太刺激了……$s

records.source: I feel faint...$8
records.translation: 我快昏倒了……$8

records.source: Harvey's blood pressure is skyrocketing!
records.translation: 哈維的血壓正在急速上升！

records.source: My body feels inflamed after that movie...$s
records.translation: 看完那部電影後，我覺得全身都在發炎……$s

records.source: I saw a commercial for this on the TV. It looks really funny!
records.translation: 我在電視上看過這部片的廣告。看起來真的很好笑！

records.source: As an amateur connoisseur, the weird obsession with gluten-based food was hilarious.$h
records.translation: 身為業餘美食鑑賞家，我覺得片中對麵筋食物的古怪迷戀實在太好笑了。$h

records.source: It doesn't feel like the holidays until you've seen '{0}'!
records.translation: 沒看過「{0}」，就不像真的在過節！

records.source: That was heartwarming... and somehow they make that fabled fruit seem so delicious. I'd love to taste it one day.
records.translation: 真溫馨……而且不知怎麼的，他們把那種傳說中的水果拍得如此美味。真希望有一天能親口嘗嘗。

records.source: They say this movie is 'unconventional'... does that mean it's bad?$s
records.translation: 他們說這部電影「不落窠臼」……意思是它很糟嗎？$s

records.source: What was the point of that one? I don't get it. Maybe I'm too old.$s
records.translation: 那部片到底想表達什麼？我看不懂。也許是我太老了。$s

records.source: *sniff* *sniff* ... I smell something delicious...
records.translation: *嗅嗅* *嗅嗅*……我聞到了美味的氣味……

records.source: Not bad at all. I'm really glad I came!
records.translation: 一點也不差。真高興自己來了！

records.source: I watched cowboy movies when I was a kid... I'm glad to see the art is still alive!
records.translation: 小時候我常看牛仔電影……很高興看到這門藝術依然存在！

records.source: (I wonder what kind of moustache wax he uses?)
records.translation: （不知道他用的是哪種鬍鬚蠟？）

records.source: Mayor Lewis seems deep in thought...
records.translation: 路易斯鎮長似乎陷入沉思……

records.source: Heh, that was great! Really brought me back...$h
records.translation: 嘿，真的很棒！讓我想起了從前……$h

records.source: The governor himself recommended this movie to me!
records.translation: 這部電影是州長本人推薦給我的！

records.source: Fantastic! They really made Stardew Valley look beautiful, didn't they? If only they had featured Pelican Town itself...$h
records.translation: 太精彩了！他們真的把星露谷拍得很美，不是嗎？如果片中也有介紹鵜鶘鎮就好了……$h

records.source: As mayor, I need to know what kinds of movies are being shown in our community. We have the tender minds of the next generation to worry about!
records.translation: 身為鎮長，我必須了解社區正在放映哪種電影。我們還得顧慮下一代尚未成熟的心靈！

records.source: Hah! That wasn't bad at all... I'd say this one's 'Mayor Approved'.$h
records.translation: 哈！一點也不差……我會說這部片獲得「鎮長認證」。$h

records.source: Hmm... I guess it will be interesting to see what the young people are watching these days...
records.translation: 嗯……看看現在的年輕人都在看些什麼，應該也挺有意思……
